title: A Novel Scalarized Scaffold Hopping Algorithm with Graph-Based Variational Autoencoder for Discovery of JAK1 Inhibitors.
summary: Generated scaffold-hopped compounds were synthesized; seven were biochemically active, including a nanomolar JAK1 inhibitor. No therapeutic efficacy established.
ai_technology: GraphGMVAE graph variational autoencoder with message-passing encoders
